summary: This Form 8-K reports the entry into an underwriting agreement by Appalachian Power Company and its special-purpose entity, Appalachian Power Recovery Funding LLC, to issue $1.3755 billion in Series 2026-A Senior Secured SAC Bonds. The transaction is a routine debt issuance under a shelf registration, with customary representations, warranties, and indemnification. This is not a special situation; it is a routine capital markets financing. No special-situation category applies.
